styles.css.description: Full published stylesheet (tokens + components + AppShell/Menu chrome). Fonts must be externalized to dist/fonts/, not base64-inlined.

styles-base.css.description: Base stylesheet (tokens + components, no AppShell/Menu chrome). Fonts must be externalized to dist/fonts/, not base64-inlined.

button.description: Button + cn + cva (tree-shaken from dist/index.js, node_modules external)

menu.description: Menu component subgraph incl. all referenced UDS sub-components (node_modules external)

branding.description: Branding.js + all lazy SVG chunks bundled (node_modules external). SVGs load lazily per-brand at runtime.

app-shell.description: AppShell subgraph, react-router-dom deferred via React.lazy (node_modules external)
